title: SonarCloud analysis-scope control and S8545 workflow remediation
goal: Reduce the SonarCloud OPEN backlog by scoping automatic analysis to shipped product code (maintainer-approved scope decision), and fix the two githubactions:S8545 findings by replacing go-install of golangci-lint with the SHA-pinned official action.

in: .sonarcloud.properties analysis-scope exclusions (scripts, frontend/scripts, database, *.sql, i18n resources)
githubactions:S8545 remediation in ci.yml and quality.yml (golangci-lint-action, SHA-pinned)
Coverage-is-empty root-cause documentation (automatic analysis imports no coverage reports)
out: Product-code issue remediation batches (follow-up tasks: small buckets, go:S1192, frontend style rules, S3776 refactors)
Switching to CI-based SonarCloud analysis (deferred post-freeze: uploading coverage would activate the Sonar way new_coverage>=80 condition against mechanical remediation PRs)
pantheon-ops work (deferred until base release is cut; ops syncs against the release)

minimumViableApproach: Commit a .sonarcloud.properties scope file (autoscan honors it; verify issue count after merge) and swap both go-install lint steps for golangci/golangci-lint-action pinned to the v9.3.0 commit, keeping golangci-lint v2.6.2 and the existing report-only/new-code gate semantics unchanged.
successCriteria: SonarCloud OPEN count drops by the excluded-scope share (~355: tooling 261, sql 47, i18n-resource S2068 FPs 47) after the next main analysis.
githubactions:S8545 no longer reported on ci.yml or quality.yml.
Lint gate behavior is unchanged: report-only full-repo on push, --new-from-rev enforcement on PR.
backend/go.mod and go.sum are untouched (go-tool route explicitly rejected: it downgraded minio-go v7.2.1 to v7.1.0 and drifted golangci-lint to 2.12.2).

Coverage root cause is documented: automatic analysis runs no tests and imports no coverage reports, so SonarCloud has no coverage metric; CI already produces backend/coverage.out and frontend lcov but nothing uploads them.
deferredCodeIssues: Remaining OPEN issues after scope control (~457) are product/test/container code and are scheduled as code-fix batches: small buckets (Dockerfile, index.html, start-dev.sh, tests), go:S1192 constants, frontend style rules, then S3776 cognitive-complexity refactors. The scope exclusions carry individual documented rationales in .sonarcloud.properties and in this manifest; no Sonar-side bulk closure is used.
